verdict.rationale: Airwallex issuing docs explicitly describe authorization controls specifying rules on how/where cards may be used, plus card issuing at scale and spend-control marketing for corporate cards, directly matching per-card limits and granular employee controls. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of the finance-lead UI experience for setting these controls, and no explicit detail on per-employee role-based permission granularity beyond authorization rules.
